slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: 天斗帝国，七宝琉璃宗本部。
演武场上，没有被带去元素谷的宗门弟子们，此刻全聚在一起，一个个兴奋得满面红光。
“痛快！
真他娘的痛快！”
一名外门管事一巴掌拍在大腿上。
“这些年咱们在外面做生意，那些强攻系、敏攻系的魂师，哪个不背地里骂咱们是只有钱的软蛋？”
“现在好了！
剑长老十万年魂环一露，我看以后谁还敢在咱们面前摆谱！”
“可不是嘛！”
旁边一个内门弟子接茬，“宗主也突破了八宝琉璃塔，咱们宗门现在的战力，绝对稳坐上三宗头把交椅！”
“对了，你们听说了火家那个火舞的事没？”
有人突然挑起话头，人群顿时发出一阵哄笑。
“早就传开了！
那火舞仗着有几分姿色，带着她爹跑去大殿退婚，还敢指着咱们少主的鼻子骂。”
“结果呢？咱们少主几句话就把她怼得哑口无言，还挨了一巴掌！”
“真是个没脑子的蠢货。
真以为自己长得漂亮点，变异了个火影武魂，全天下的男人都得围着她转？”
“也不拿镜子照照自己！
就她那个暴脾气，白给咱们少主提鞋，少主都嫌烫脚！”
“就是！
水冰儿那是极品冰凤凰，长得又是国色天香，这才是咱们七宝琉璃宗少夫人的排面！”
宗门上下，一片欢腾。
对于宁天无法修炼这件事，弟子们早就习以为常。
反正宗门有的是钱，少主就算是个普通人，那也是顶配的普通人。
只要能给宗门长脸，大家就认！
不过，比起七宝琉璃宗的欢腾，别的势力，就未必了。
武魂殿，教皇殿。
高台的教皇宝座上，比比东单手撑着额头，听完汇报后，整个人陷入了长久的沉默。
站在一旁的胡列娜忍不住往前走了一步。
“老师，情报是不是搞错了？”
胡列娜眉头紧蹙，满脸的不敢置信。
“剑道尘心卡在九十六级多年，他去哪里弄来的十万年魂环？”
“还有那个宁风致，七宝琉璃塔历代宗主都受制于武魂缺陷，终生无法突破魂圣，他凭什么能变异出八层？”
比比东没有直接回答徒弟的话，只是开口道。
“月关，情报来源可靠么？”
一旁的菊斗罗赶紧回应。
“回教皇冕下，千真万确。”
“玉罗冕当时不知死活出言挑衅，被剑斗罗仅用威压就震得吐血倒地。”
月关咽了口唾沫，“外面现在传得沸沸扬扬，说七宝琉璃宗这次去提亲，带了十八车聘礼。”
“坊间越传越玄乎，有的甚至说里面装了三块万年级别的极品魂骨！”
比比东冷笑了一声。
“万年魂骨？宁风致就算再财大气粗，也不会拿万年魂骨去给一个没用的废柴儿子当彩礼。”
content_en:
Tiandou Empire, the headquarters of Qibao Glazed Sect.
On the martial arts field, the disciples of the sect who had not been taken to the Elemental Valley were all gathered together at this moment, their faces glowing with excitement.
"Happy!
What a fucking pleasure! "
An outside steward slapped her on the thigh.
"We have been doing business outside these years. Among those soul masters of the power attack and agility attack systems, who doesn't secretly accuse us of being weaklings who only have money?"
"It's fine now!
Once Elder Sword's hundred thousand year soul ring is revealed, I wonder who will dare to show off in front of us in the future! "
"That's right!"
An inner disciple next to him continued, "The sect master has also broken through the Eight Treasure Glazed Tile Tower. Our sect's current combat power will definitely secure the top spot among the three sects!"
"By the way, have you heard about Huo Wu from the Huo family?"
Someone suddenly started talking, and the crowd burst into laughter.
"It has been spread for a long time!
Taking advantage of her beauty, Huo Wu took her father to the main hall to break off the engagement, and she even dared to point at our young master's nose and scold him. "
"The result? Our young master silenced her with just a few words and even received a slap in the face!"
"What a mindless idiot.
Do you really think that if you look more beautiful and mutate into a Hokage martial spirit, all the men in the world will surround her? "
“Don’t even look at yourself in the mirror!
Because of her bad temper, she even carried our young master's shoes for nothing, and the young master even found it hot to his feet! "
"That's right!
Shui Bing'er is a top-quality ice phoenix, and she looks gorgeous and fragrant. This is what our Qibao Glazed Sect young lady looks like! "
The entire sect was filled with joy.
Disciples have long been accustomed to Ning Tian's inability to practice.
Anyway, the sect has a lot of money, and even if the young master is an ordinary person, he is still a top-notch ordinary person.
As long as it can bring face to the sect, everyone will recognize it!
However, compared to the joy of the Qibao Glazed Sect, other forces may not be as happy.
Wuhun Palace, Pope Palace.
On the papal throne on the high platform, Bibi Dong held her forehead with one hand. After listening to the report, she fell into a long silence.
Hu Liena, who was standing aside, couldn't help but take a step forward.
"Teacher, is the information wrong?"
Hu Liena frowned, her face full of disbelief.
"Sword Dao Chenxin has been stuck at level ninety-six for many years. Where did he get the hundred thousand year soul ring?"
"And that Ning Fengzhi, the previous sect masters of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda were all affected by the defects of their martial souls and could not break through to the Soul Saint in their lifetime. How could he mutate to the eighth level?"
Bibi Dong did not directly answer the disciple's words, but just said.
"Yueguan, is the source of the information reliable?"
Ju Douluo on the side quickly responded.
"It's absolutely true to return to the Pope's crown."
"Yu Luo Mian didn't know how to live or die at that time and made provocations. Sword Douluo was so shocked that he vomited blood and fell to the ground with just his coercion."
"And..."
Yue Guan swallowed, "There are rumors outside that the Qibao Glazed Sect went to propose marriage this time and brought eighteen carts of betrothal gifts."
"The rumors are getting more and more mysterious. Some even say that it contains three top-quality soul bones that are ten thousand years old!"
Bibi Dong sneered.
"Ten thousand-year soul bones? No matter how wealthy Ning Fengzhi is, he will not use his ten-thousand-year soul bones as a gift to a useless good-for-nothing son."
